items.title: Joe Wilder — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I had another thing when I was doing The Barbara McNair Show at ABC.

ctx.x: Yeah, and time is precious these days.

Yeah, it is that. Let’s see if I – something I – I have two things here I should have mentioned. We talking sometimes about the racial aspect of some of these things. When we did – when I did The Most Happy Fella, Frank Loesser, who was, incidentally, one of the most remarkable people. He was the most down-to-earth – one of the most down-to-earth people I’ve ever run into, with that much talent. When we did Most Happy Fella, he decided that he should throw a big party at the 21 Club. They had never – they didn’t…
